body:
Confirm. I can reproduce it.

```
Godot v4.6.1.stable - Fedora Linux 42 (Cinnamon) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - (software emulation on CPU) llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.8, 256 bits) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4770 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads) - 31.27 GiB memory
```

It's can be reduced to:

```gdscript
var error: String
error.is_valid_filename() # Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

But next example work fine:

```gdscript
var error: String = ""
error.is_valid_filename() # now it's fine
```

> StringName.is_valid_filename() is also crashing so more investigation is needed

They are actually the same thing ;)

`bind_string_method(is_valid_filename, sarray(), varray());`
```
#define bind_string_method(m_method, m_arg_names, m_default_args) \
	bind_method(String, m_method, m_arg_names, m_default_args); \
	bind_convert_method(StringName, String, m_method, m_arg_names, m_default_args);
```

```
james@neptune:~/Godot/crash-test$ addr2line -e crash_test.x86_64 0x3a311d0
/home/james/Godot/godot/./core/templates/cowdata.h:227
```

Optimisations are messing things up, still crashes with `lto=none` but that doesn't help the stacktrace. Turning down the optimisation level of course made the bug go away.

It would _appear_ to be in either `CowData<T>::_unref()` (according to addr2line) or `CowData<T>::size()` (according to the trace) or somewhere nearby.
The most likely scenario would seem to be the it was in both (`_unref()` calls `size()`), however I could not find a Span comparison anywhere in either (or in `_get_size()`, which `size()` calls).

I can't test it since it doesn't crash on my machine, so I'd appreciate if someone who runs into this could [test the PR](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/pull_requests/testing.html)!
